results.title: Richard Riehle, dependable TV and film character actor who was in 'Glory' and 'Office Space,' dies
results.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Richard Riehle, a prolific character actor in TV and film who often played authority figures but was equally skilled at comedy, notably playing a sad-sack product manager in “Office Space,” has died. He was 78.
